units.function: Pure orchestration tests for realizing an already-leased workspace, persisting realization metadata, executing optional remote provisioning and resolving/converting the final adapter execution target.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> run orchestrator -> mocked workspace request builder, environment runtime, target resolver/converter and metadata/activity services; no database, filesystem, network, provider, Secret store or lease lifecycle is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Environment and active lease, source and persisted execution workspace, versioned realization request/result, authoritative root/mode/path mappings, runtime provisioning command, execution target/remote spec and staged EnvironmentRunError.
units.lifecycle: Receive selected environment/lease/workspace -> build realization request -> realize or reuse remote/in-place workspace -> persist lease and workspace metadata -> run optional shell provisioning -> resolve target transport -> attach realization contract and return execution inputs.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 9/9. It clearly pins stage ordering, in-place cwd and basic error codes. It does not cover path/content integrity, partial metadata persistence, retries/concurrency/crash recovery, provisioning policy or idempotency, cleanup/release, cancellation/timeouts, audit/evidence, data egress and attestation.
units.designRationale: Give adapters a uniform workspace and remote target while allowing runtime-specific copy versus in-place realization and optional installation of their command-line runtime before Agent startup.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs deterministic, recoverable preparation of Connector execution workspaces and binaries, with the exact prepared state bound to a Work contract and safe across managed/local nodes.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the versioned realization contract, authoritative-root projection and stage-specific orchestration. Replace arbitrary shell provisioning with signed declarative packages/steps and capability policy; add content/binary/image digests, path containment, idempotency keys, durable stage state, saga cleanup/reconciliation, structured redacted errors and signed responsibility evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: Provisioning changes an execution node and can download/execute code, yet no accountable human, approval, package identity, data/tool policy or evidence digest is bound. Activity is not asserted, and partial success could leave an untracked modified workspace used by later Runs.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL arbitrary provisioning surface: unversioned strings execute through bash -lc without tested allowlisting, signature, privilege, egress or approval controls. HIGH partial-side-effect gap: remote realization/provisioning and separate metadata writes lack tested idempotency, compensation and recovery. HIGH path/content-attestation gap: authoritative roots and mappings are accepted without integrity/containment proof. HIGH error disclosure gap: raw remote stderr is included in a conflated realization error. HIGH responsibility gap: no approved human/package/Work/evidence binding.
